newsitem.title: USA: First of Mich president candidate resigns.
newsitem.headline: First of Mich president candidate resigns.

text.p: First of Michigan said Wednesday that Robert Michelotti, who agreed last week to become the brokerage firm's new president, has decided to return to his former employer, Roney & Co.
First of Michigan said its executives were surprised and disappointed by the decision.

First of Michigan Chairman Edward Soule said, "Although we are disappointed by Bob Michelotti's decision, after he made the commitment to join our firm, we have a strong senior- management team and this has no bearing on the service we provide our clients on a day-to-day basis."
